verdict.rationale: The Agent API's tools documentation lists "Your own remote MCP server" as a tool type: the model discovers and calls that server's tools, and approvals can gate each call. This is a direct, first-party MCP-client capability. Evidence about Perplexity's own hosted MCP server is the server role and is not credited here. missing for 10: support for local/stdio MCP servers (only remote is documented), configuration detail such as auth and tool filtering for user-supplied servers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
